findings.what: The G-P bit-probe mixes the overlap signal with generic crashes. Overlap -> raise RuntimeError -> 'Notebook Threw Exception'. But any exception outside run_probe's try block also gives 'Threw Exception' and would be misread as 'overlap exists'. This covers the module-writing cell, write_csv on the 'csv' path, and an OOM or dead kernel. A false ERROR would open the K6 path on a hidden set with no overlaps; K6 would then be a no-op copy of K2 and waste a slot plus a 7.5 h run. Probe failures inside the try correctly give 'CSV Not Found'.

findings.action: Before the G-P submit (an encoding change, not a gate change; log it in CONTEXT before the submit): (a) give the overlap signal its own class.
